So the body: in the drawing's top view, the body is 2.64/2.10 horizontally?? Hmm, but for a SOT-23, body is 2.92 × 1.30 (per the description on page 1: DBZ 2.92 mm × 1.3 mm). And horizontal 2.10-2.64 corresponds to body width incl. mold flash tolerance? Standard SOT-23 body width is 1.30 mm; 2.10-2.64 includes the leads sticking out on left? Keep as starter. standoff 0.05 (drawing gage plane 0.25? Actually standoff for SOT-23 ~0.1). The drawing shows "0.20 TYP/0.08" vertical lead thickness? The bottom-left view shows "0.25 GAGE PLANE" and "0.20 TYP/0.08" — likely standoff? No, gage plane 0.25 is the coplanarity gage; 0.20/0.08 = lead thickness range? Then 0.10 TYP in side view is... hmm.

The functions: for D+ and D-, function label e.g. "esd_port" / signal analog, direction passive/bidirectional, peripheral "TVS" role "d+/d-"? Let me define peripheral "ESD" with roles... pins.name: D+
pins.note: High-speed ESD clamp port (datasheet type 'ESD port'). Unidirectional TVS diode to GND, VBR 7 V, VRWM 5.5 V typ, 0.9 pF (DBZ). Shares one TVS diode with D- (page 9). Flow-through mapping: pin 1 and pin 2 are the two ends of the protected differential pair.

pins.name: D-
pins.note: High-speed ESD clamp port (datasheet type 'ESD port'). Second half of the differential pair protected by the same TVS diode as pin 1.

pins.name: GND
pins.note: Ground / clamp return (datasheet type 'GND'). Must be connected to the ground plane the ESD current returns through.

rules.label: gnd_return_required
rules.script: if !active("GND", "GND") { require("TPD2E009 GND (pin 3) must be assigned to ground: the TVS clamp has no other return path for the ESD current.", ["GND"]) } else { ok() }

rules.label: both_esd_ports_together
rules.script: if active_count(["D+.D+", "D-.D-"]) == 1 { warn("D+ (pin 1) and D- (pin 2) share one TVS diode inside the TPD2E009; protecting only one line of the differential pair leaves the other unprotected and unbalances the pair. Use both ESD ports together.") } else { ok() }

rules.label: no_power_supply_pin
rules.script: if used("ESD") && (role("ESD", "D+") && role("ESD", "D-")) { warn("The TPD2E009 is a passive clamp with no supply pin: keep D+ and D- within 0 V to 5.5 V (VRWM 5.5 V, VBR 7 V) and do not drive either port above 5.5 V.") } else { ok() }

report.summary: Built the TPD2E009 as a 3-terminal passive ESD-protection part, DBZ (SOT-23) package only, per the request. Pinout: pin 1 D+, pin 2 D- (both 'ESD port', one shared TVS clamp to GND), pin 3 GND, from the page-3 Pin Functions table; one peripheral 'ESD' with roles D+ and D-, no GPIO/mux (the part has none - no IO MUX, strapping, debug or power pins exist, so no flash/JTAG/USB rules apply). Three rules were added instead: GND must be assigned (require), a warn when only one of the two ESD ports is used (they share one TVS diode, page 9), and a warn that the passive clamp has no supply and its ports must stay within 0-5.5 V. Preview was clean (no refusal, no rule failure; the only blocking findings before the footprint existed were package.envelope and binding.footprint_count, both resolved by the package build). Package/footprint from the DBZ0003A outline (page 17) and its example land pattern (page 18) using the built-in SOT-23-3 tabbed starter row, values corrected: body 2.92 x 1.3 x 0.95 mm, tip-to-tip span 2.4 mm, lead width 0.4, thickness 0.12, foot length 0.4, standoff 0.05, pitch 0.95 (starter/generator convention: the built footprint places pads 1 and 2 1.9 mm apart, which equals the drawing's boxed 1.9 dimension, and the rows 2.1 mm apart = the land pattern's (2.1)); lands 0.6 wide x 1.3 long taken from the recommended pattern (3X (0.6) / 3X (1.3) / 2X (0.95) / (2.1)) rather than the starter's estimates. Terminals matched by number (3 kept, 0 renumbered). Generated 3D model kept (no built-in SolidCraft part file covers a bare SOT-23-3; esp32-s31-wroom-3 is a module and was not used). Can marking set to text 'NFLR' (laser etch); no vendor logo, no polarity mark (the drawing shows a moulded pin-1 index area, which the footprint's pin-1 dot and polarity pad already represent). Everything is unreviewed (3 imported terminals) and not published. Check first: the derived lead foot length/standoff and body height (see open questions), and that only the DBZ variant was requested - the DRT (1.0 x 0.8 mm) option was deliberately not built.
